title: AlphaFold2 structures guide prospective ligand discovery
summary: AlphaFold2 structures guide prospective ligand discovery. AlphaFold2 predicted structures of the sigma-2 and 5-HT2A receptors were used as unrefined docking targets for large library screens. Hundreds of new molecules were tested; hit rates and affinities were similar to experimental-structure docking, and a cryo-EM structure of one 5-HT2A ligand was determined. Evidence limits: Full text not read; generality beyond two receptors is not established by the abstract. The AI model supplies the target structure, not the ligand ranking. Reviewed from Europe PMC abstract only.
